title: Friendship Flag Exchange # 22
summary: Rtn Vidya and Jagdish Moorjani exchanged the 22nd flag exchange on the 22nd of October with rotary Club of Delhi CP Raisina Hills.
description: Rtn Vidya and Jagdish Moorjani exchanged the 22nd flag exchange on the 22nd of October with rotary Club of Delhi CP Raisina Hills. The Rotarians from the Delhi Club braved Delhi traffic and drove for an hour just to meet our Bayviewites. Vidya said this was a wonderful discussion and as they explored the possibility of collaborating on joint projects in Delhi, this could be the beginning of some meaningful partnerships.
